source_evidence: Exact player 'See for yourself. I am not just a member of my house. I am the Viscount.' V invites the custodian to inspect him and asserts his title. Does not command attack, surrender weapons, offer evidence or move. The first fixed warder independently walks from (0,20) to (0,5) inside receiving hall, lifts inside bar and opens receiving door inward to examine claimant, armed and wary. V remains outside with Fenar at front and Cirren behind. Newly fixed exterior approach positions relative to entry(0,0) along stair axis: Fenar(0,-5), V(0,-10), Cirren(0,-15), following actual descent order; these are approximate along-stair distances, not flat elevation claims. Wight at(0,5) just within entrance; two fixed skeletons remain(-10,15)/(10,15), visible where doorway lines permit, no automatic through-door sight or attack. Wight visibly studies V and floating silver sword without recognizing V, lineage, particular sword history or validity of title; remarks on claimed Viscount and missing memory, treats claim with suspicion. He refuses passage while armed, demands weapons lowered/surrendered before entry as part of hostile custodial intent; V chooses whether to comply, challenge, talk, withdraw or fight. No authority check or automatic obedience, no new secret history, no V action beyond spoken claim, no attack, initiative, surprise, movement, resource use or new evidence. Door open; warder armed, receiving hall dimly lit by stair daylight at entrance; further interior dark. Second fixed group remains behind separate closed doors without alert or reposition. At approximately Day331 16:31.
